subject: Intro + Demo: Redwood Inference x Finlytics (referred by TechSys)
messages:
From: Aamir Qureshi <aamir@techsys.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Clara Gomez <clara.gomez@finlytics.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Intro: Finlytics -> Redwood (demo request)

Jasmine / Redwood team —

Hope you’re both doing well. I’m looping you in from TechSys (SI partner) — we’ve been working with Finlytics on an evaluation of several inference platforms and they specifically asked to see Redwood based on the performance benchmarks you shared at last week’s partner call. Clara (Finlytics) is the point person and would like a short product demo to cover: latency/cost profile for batch scoring, SSO/KMS controls, and a quick look at the Dedicated offering.

Clara — small intro: Jasmine is our SDR handling inbound demos, Laura is the AE who’ll run the session, and Dev is the SE for technical Q&A. Would you be able to share a couple of times that work next week? If you prefer, Marcus can send a scheduling link.

Thanks — happy to join the call as well.

— Aamir
TechSys Solutions
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Gomez <clara.gomez@finlytics.co>
Cc: Aamir Qureshi <aamir@techsys.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Finlytics -> Redwood (demo request)

Hi Clara —

Thanks for the intro Aamir! Clara, great to meet you — I’m Jasmine on the Redwood inbound team. Would love to get a 30-minute demo scheduled to walk through the items Aamir called out. A few slots that are open on our side next week (all times in PST):

- Mon 3/22, 10:00–10:30am
- Tue 3/23, 11:00–11:30am
- Wed 3/24, 9:00–9:30am

If none of those work I can get Marcus to send a scheduling link. We’ll plan for Laura (AE) + Dev (SE) to join for the technical Q&A and SSO/KMS discussion.

Anything specific you want us to include in the agenda (SSO provider, data residency, sample throughput)? Happy to tailor.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Clara Gomez <clara.gomez@finlytics.co>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Aamir Qureshi <aamir@techsys.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Finlytics -> Redwood (demo request)

Hi Jasmine / Aamir —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We’re based in PST. The ideal time for us would be Mon 3/22 at 10:00am PST for a 30-minute session — that should be enough for an overview + Q&A.

Agenda items we care most about:
- SSO / SCIM integration (we use Okta)
- Data residency and logging (SOC2/regulatory concerns)
- Typical latency and cost for batch scoring (models similar to Llama-2 family; 2k token avg)

Aamir — I’ll invite our CTO and a security analyst depending on final time.

Thanks, looking forward.

— Clara
Head of Product, Finlytics
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Gomez <clara.gomez@finlytics.co>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Aamir Qureshi <aamir@techsys.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T10:15:00Z
Subject: Redwood demo invite — Mon 3/22 10:00am PST (30m)

Hi Clara —

Great — locking in Mon 3/22, 10:00–10:30am PST for a 30-minute demo. I’ve put together a short agenda and attached it here. Also attaching a calendar invite (.ics) — please accept and I’ll update if anything changes.

Attendees from Redwood: Laura Bennett (AE), Dev Patel (SE), Marcus Lin (SDR).
Attendees from Finlytics: Clara Gomez (+ potentially CTO and security).

Attachment: Redwood-Demo-Agenda.pdf (1 page — overview, SSO/SCIM, latency/cost, Q&A)
Attachment: calendar-invite.ics

Link to deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/D-2026-0781

Let me know if you want any pre-read.

Thanks — Marcus
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Clara Gomez <clara.gomez@finlytics.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aamir Qureshi <aamir@techsys.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood demo invite — Mon 3/22 10:00am PST (30m)

Hi Marcus / team —

Apologies — a calendar conflict just came up for Monday. Could we move to Wed 3/24 at 9:00am PST instead? That time works for our CTO and security analyst. Aamir will still be joining.

Also, can you confirm whether someone from the security/compliance team will be available for a few minutes, or alternatively share the SSO/SCIM checklist in advance? We want to make sure we cover SCIM provisioning and KMS integration.

Thanks —
Clara
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Gomez <clara.gomez@finlytics.co>

Subject: Re: Redwood demo invite — rescheduled to Wed 3/24 9:00am PST

Hi Clara —

Thanks for the heads up — we’ve rescheduled the demo to Wed 3/24, 9:00–9:30am PST and updated the calendar invite (you should see a new invite). Attendees confirmed: Laura (AE), Dev (SE) and I; Marcus will stay on deck for follow-ups. Aamir — thanks for coordinating from TechSys.

Per your request, attaching our SSO/SCIM checklist and a short pre-read on KMS integrations — Dev will be available during the call to answer deeper questions. If your security analyst would like more detailed material ahead of time we can loop in our compliance engineer.

Attachments: SSO-checklist.pdf (redwood_sso_scim_v1.pdf)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/D-2026-0781

See you on Wed 3/24 —
Jasmine
